researchHypotheses.statement: Dom(D) consists of sequences with sum k^2(|a_(k,+)|^2+|a_(k,-)|^2)<infinity; its adjoint domain is the same.
The zeros of the det2 candidate are the signed integer spectrum with multiplicity. They are not asserted to be Riemann zeros.
Use det2(I-z D^-1), normalized by F(0)=1 and F'(0)=0, with no extra trivial-zero factor.
The inverse-square trace is the sum of squared reciprocal eigenvalues; finite cutoffs need separate tails.
The paired signed spectrum proposes F(z)=F(-z). A relation to xi requires a further unproved bridge.
The supplied identity quadratic form is positive; it does not identify any Riemann Weil-positivity form.
